scope: Part 3 exact public npm data acquisition, immutable GitHub candidate archives and unavailable provenance boundary

verifier.reason: No direct-artifact verifier plus exact-subject fixture, explicit independently configured expected identity policy and admitted trust-root workflow is operational. npm's documented audit-signatures route assumes an installed dependency graph. No analyzed package installation is performed as a shortcut.
verifier.acceptanceGap: Released version/digest/API/runtime/license/transitive/security admission, real positive subject-bound integration and signer/issuer/predicate/source/builder/trust-root rejection tests remain open.
verifier.status: not_checked; raw advertised attestations are retained as unverified data only

reusedRuntime.api: Existing Node HTTPS/DNS/crypto/fs APIs; SHA-256 and SHA-512 SRI only; bounded version metadata and GitHub git-ref/git-tag API responses; no Git executable, npm install/pack, scripts or model calls.
reusedRuntime.platform: Existing macOS arm64 host plus restricted Linux arm64 static parser. No broader runtime or remote CI result claimed.

inputPolicy.registry: https://registry.npmjs.org only; exact canonical name/version, including scoped names
inputPolicy.sri: Canonical padded SHA-512/SHA-256 base64 tokens, at most 16. Use strongest supported algorithm; reject unsupported/malformed tokens without downgrade. No SHA-1 acceptance.
inputPolicy.source: Immutable full-40-lowercase-hex GitHub archive URL; observed metadata/manifest/tag/user claims kept separately; no Git object or signed-tag verification
inputPolicy.tagDiscovery: At most 3 repositories, vVERSION and VERSION, at most 4 annotated-tag peel requests per ref; capture missing/wrong/conflicting refs, never request a default branch
inputPolicy.network: Existing DNS/IP pinning/redirect/credential/proxy restrictions; additionally constrain every request/redirect to registry, API or codeload host for its stage
inputPolicy.unsupportedEntries: Retain bounded inert rejected-name/link prefixes and original archive; unknown remaining scope. Unsupported archive policy is unchanged.
inputPolicy.execution: No target installation/import/hook/build, no rebuild or model execution

rights.product: Original new code Apache-2.0; previous dependency notices/pins carry forward
rights.fixtures: picocolors ISC; ts-pattern MIT; zod MIT; @vue/shared MIT. Retain the actual original artifact LICENSE files and evidence refs; no claim that metadata alone grants rights.
rights.redistribution: Public evidence remains local. No registry upload, report publication or external message authorized.
rights.sourceSnapshots: Broader public source snapshots can carry additional third-party notices. Retained locally; review broader-source redistribution obligations before any approved publication. Root Apache-2.0 does not relicense upstream material.

retrievalLimit: Connected Firecrawl was out of credits; official web/API fallback used. No new dependency admission or fresh full image vulnerability scan is claimed.
